name: Contract renewal and notice register
summary: From your signed agreements and amendments, the contracts manager gets a register for counsel to confirm: each term, renewal and notice clause quoted with its section, cancel-by and send-by dates proposed only under counsel's own counting rules, and the windows sorted by proposed send-by date. Nothing is sent.

sources.title: The register read from the signed agreements and amendments, with every clause quoted and located; dates proposed only under the company's lawyer-approved counting rules with the working shown; and the line-by-line list counsel confirms, written for this workflow template.

sources.contribution: Separate notice-period and send dates for each notice window, counting from the current term end carried forward at each renewal, moving a deadline off a closed day to an earlier day, grouping windows by how soon they come with those already behind listed apart, and the business owner deciding renewal after a lawyer's look.
